Host source checks should cover known/unknown/zero/overflow/incomplete schema cases. Keep stderr and initial failures.

Use the proposed45-host-second OR6,000,000,000-primary-cycle bound at normal polling, record overshoot, stop further firmware commands at deadline, existing15-second normal join. Missing FINI/unload stays failure. No root-cause claim for interpreter nonreproduction/unknown origin or host ordering as exact phase. This work is independent of palette21; do not let diagnostic preparation replace the useful colour proof. Return frozen inputs/request; no target grant in this message. Root has begun only source research of possible failure rollback, not firmware changes. No mapping/alias/limit/repair/profile replacement/GUI/hardware/publication.
